title: graph
instructions: This server stores entities as bundles of components. Use graph_schema to see the available components and their properties; use graph_query or graph_show to read them, and graph_apply to write changes.

graph_apply.title: Apply atomic changes
graph_apply.description: Create, edit, link or delete entities atomically via edits/links, q, bundles, or id/text (path defaults to doc.body). Ids accept eids, human ids and names; $name creates an entity reusable within this call. Omitted fields stay; null clears properties/components. Text edits replace literal find (one match unless all), then prepend/append; reads are guarded automatically, with optional was tokens. links add relations; drop removes them. q patches one entity: T-12 .doc.title="New title" !blocked; $new .task creates one. bundles use [{entity:{eid},component:{fields}}], $was guards and $delete deletes. Returns applied bundles with resolved ids, $alias and stamps. check previews then rolls back; reuse $names, since preview ids are temporary. graph_schema lists fields. https://yaks.app/docs/store

q.description: One entity patch; quote spaced values: T-12 .doc.title="two words". Values follow schema types; null clears (even quoted), !component removes. $name or fresh UUID creates.

bundles.description: Atomic bundles: entity:{eid} plus components. eid accepts existing id/name or new $name; edges derive theirs from ends.

set.description: Dotted fields or whole components, e.g. {"doc.title":"New","blocked":null}.

path.description: Text property, e.g. doc.body or content.body.

was.description: Read tokens keyed by dotted field path.

edits.description: Changes to any entities, applied together.

id.description: Entity to replace text on; $name creates.

path.description: Text property for id/text; default doc.body.

graph_query.title: Query entities
graph_query.description: Query .component.property=value with & (and), | (or), bare search words, presence .component/!component, or ?component to include without filtering. Always qualify properties. Operators: != ~= < >, lists a,b, ranges 1..9. Directives: .order=-created.at .limit=20 .fields=doc.title .refs=T-12. filters narrow all of q. Returns named components; * or no named component returns whole entities. Bare search defaults to 20 compact hits. doc.body includes $was. graph_show reads whole entities; graph_schema lists vocabulary. https://yaks.app/docs/querying

graph_show.title: Show entities
graph_show.description: Read whole entities by eid, human id or name, once each. $was.doc.body holds its SHA-256 for guarded writes. Missing ids are reported; all missing refuses. Backlinks: graph_query .refs=<id>; text search: search.

graph_schema.title: Read the schema
graph_schema.description: Read vocabulary JSON Schema. No arguments returns a component/property index; component returns full declarations, types, refs and write examples. kind returns its definition and associated components, taking precedence over component. https://yaks.app/docs/components

search.title: Search text
search.description: Search indexed words and, with vectors, meaning. Ranked compact bundles contain entity.eid and hit:{id,title,kind,excerpt,source}; source is text, meaning or both. In excerpts, \u0001/\u0002 delimit matches. graph_show reads whole entities. https://yaks.app/docs/querying
